title: Provenance and licence inventory: SBOM, third-party notices, private-data scan, dependency and vulnerability checks

fixture.generator: scripts/provenance_inventory.py run with the development interpreter; --check compares its stable sections (project, components, assets, open_items, history_note) with the committed docs/validation/sbom.json and regenerates docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md from the committed SBOM
fixture.pip_closure: every distribution reachable from [project].dependencies and every optional-dependencies group of pyproject.toml through Requires-Dist with environment markers evaluated for this interpreter
fixture.non_pip_assets: the hand-maintained ASSETS table of the generator: frontend bundle libraries with versions from package-lock.json, fonts, material tables, own artwork, manuscript, validation records, reference outputs of other solvers, application records, examples and fixtures, and the three vendor-derived items
fixture.scan_inputs: every tracked path from git ls-files except binaries and the four files that spell the patterns; positions only, never the matched text
fixture.pattern_samples: fourteen positive and nine benign strings in tests/test_provenance_inventory.py, assembled at run time with synthetic addresses and parametrized under short labels so that no sample reaches a test id or a JUnit report
fixture.history_query: git log --pickaxe-regex -S'C:[/\\]+Users[/\\]+admin' HEAD, keeping the commits whose tree still contains the pattern
fixture.dependency_check: python -m pip check in the same interpreter
fixture.vulnerability_audit: pip-audit -r <pinned closure> --no-deps, recorded in the SBOM when run with --audit and carried forward otherwise

seed: not applicable: the inputs are the tracked tree and the installed metadata
backend: cpu; no simulation and no CUDA context
reference_method: pyproject.toml as the list of declared dependencies; package-lock.json as the frontend version reference; docs/RELEASE_REVIEW.md as the list of unresolved distribution items; the pattern samples as the scan oracle

observables.name: findings
observables.definition: scan findings on the tracked tree

observables.name: components
observables.definition: distributions in the closure and how many are installed with a licence label and a source URL

observables.name: open_items
observables.definition: items with BLOCKED_EXTERNAL semantics in the SBOM and the notices

observables.name: history_commits
observables.definition: commits on HEAD whose tree contains the historic workstation path

observables.name: audit_status
observables.definition: pip-audit status recorded in the SBOM: CLEAN, FINDINGS, NOT_RUN or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL

acceptance.check: --check exits 0 with no finding and no problem on the committed tree, and pip check exits 0
acceptance.coverage: every declared dependency of pyproject.toml appears in the SBOM installed with a version and a source URL, and with a licence label or an open item; every asset in the table has a status among cleared, own and open; three.js and lucide versions match package-lock.json
acceptance.open_items: the installed-API property catalogue, the FSP layout support and the aggregate commercial timing table are open items with state BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and appear in the notices document; nothing with an unclear licence is omitted
acceptance.scan: each positive sample matches its pattern and no benign sample matches any pattern; the generated SBOM and notices match no pattern and contain no venv, site-packages or Hangul account path
acceptance.history: the commits that carry the historic workstation path are listed in the notices as a known history note and are not counted as findings
acceptance.audit: the pip-audit result is recorded as a statement about the development interpreter with fix versions; advisories do not fail --check, which is the G9-06 release-environment concern
acceptance.source_of_limits: the brief of G9-02 in docs/COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md section 11 and docs/RELEASE_REVIEW.md

not_yet_covered: a transitive SBOM of the wheel as installed in a clean environment (the inventory reads the development interpreter)
the scan of the git history itself beyond the pickaxe of the one historic path pattern

notes: Declared at 4c5a871 before the first inventory run. The run that recorded this case also redacted the workstation account path from three beyond-VRAM records; the redaction is recorded in the notices history note.
